question: What attainment comes from recitation performed at midnight?
premises: Recitation is performed in connection with midnight.
The practitioner becomes near to Brahman-attainment.
inference: Midnight recitation brings one close to the attainment of Brahman.
uncertainties: The exact quantity of recitation is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having recited at midnight, one comes near to attaining Brahman.
